title: CORNER READOUT ONE QUIET LABEL STYLE
why: Critic: the credits, xp, stash and bag readout used four treatments. Labels and the stash and bag figures now share one style (16px, 600, second text colour, 0.04em).

edits.anchor: #topright .trsub{ position:static; display:inline; line-height:inherit; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; color:var(--ash); }   /* v28.xx (cw-trrow): was a second line hanging under the readout (absolute, top 40px); now inline in the one row */
